utility.notes: The city distinguishes SCE delivery, line maintenance and billing from EPIC generation.

value.name: Energy for Palmdale's Independent Choice (EPIC)
value.notes: EPIC supplies generation; SCE delivers electricity and bills customers. Check the account's enrollment.

generation_supplier.notes: The city announcement is archived; it directly establishes the CCA relationship, not current rates or individual enrollment.

county.notes: The city is listed under Los Angeles County in SCE's reliability directory.

permit_url.notes: Eligible contractors obtain SolarAPP+ approval, then upload it to the city's linked Accela portal and complete the city application.

interconnection_url.notes: SCE's FAQ links its online interconnection system; utility approval is separate from city permitting.

value.name: California SGIP - current category and budget check required
value.description: Ratepayer budgets are closed to new applicants; RSSE funds are exhausted and waitlisted.
value.eligibility: Category and program-administrator rules apply; consult the live budget tracker.

battery_programs.notes: SCE's closure/waitlist notice and the joint utility administrators' handbook and tracker were checked live. The schema has no closed/waitlisted status; no active award or amount is asserted.

value.name: State declaration by license holder, or agent with notarized authorization
value.required_when: Listed in the city's SolarAPP+ attachment instructions

required_documents.notes: The attachment section says three documents but enumerates four, including the declaration. Retain all listed items and confirm the upload categories in Accela.

value: Schedule the inspection online in the city's Accela account.
For revisions, obtain SolarAPP+ approval, upload the revised checklist to the original BSA record and have it available for inspection.
inspection_steps.notes: The city's linked instructions provide these steps; field revisions can require additional inspection fees.

timeline_days.notes: No numeric city solar-permit turnaround was verified. Instant-permit wording is not an end-to-end deadline.

other_conditions: A licensed contractor must register with SolarAPP+.
Commercial and multifamily projects use standard city permitting.
The city's linked instructions exclude mobile homes and solar batteries/energy storage systems.

eligibility_constraints.notes: These are Palmdale's published pathway limits, not a claim about SolarAPP+ capabilities in other jurisdictions.

permit_fees.notes: The live Building & Safety page links an FY 2025-26 schedule. Its continuing applicability on 2026-09-30 was not established; amounts are retained only in research evidence.

rebates.notes: No additional current solar rebate was verified; this does not mean no rebate exists.
